fee_notes: New franchisees: greater of 7.25% or $3,000/month minimum. Renewal franchisees: 7% first year then 7.25% thereafter, same $3,000 minimum. Marketing/National Promotion fund: 2.25% in 2026, 2.50% in 2027, 2.75% in 2028+. Software License Fee $300/year, Software Maintenance Fee $225/month. Technology Fee currently none but can be up to 1% of gross revenue.
raw_excerpt: Continuing Royalty For New Franchisees: The greater of (i) 7.25% of your previous month's Gross Revenues, or (ii) the "Minimum Royalty" of $3,000 per month.
